items.note: Proposes an LLM-augmented divergent-thinking method for novice designers and tests it with the AUT and conceptual design tasks, reporting higher fluency, flexibility, and originality; the abstract does not state the comparison condition, assignment, or sample size.

University of Oulu thesis in which 18 students did structured design exercises under human-only ideation, online image search, and GenAI tools (ChatGPT, Midjourney), examining creative performance and design fixation; repository page returns 403, so the abstract was read only through a search summary and the year, degree, and scoring are unconfirmed; below 50 participants.

Compares human-human teams with human-plus-AI teams (an AI 'Disruptive Interjector' that offers suggestions) on a design sketching task, with ideas rated by trained judges; the abstract does not say whether the AI is generative or how teams were assigned, and data are posted on GitHub.

Experiment (n=52) of individual brainstorming in a human-only condition versus a human+AI condition with access to GPT-3.5-generated ideas, finding higher flexibility with AI ideas; may share data with Memmert et al. (2025).

System paper (Varif.ai, LLM plus text-to-image) with a controlled evaluation of 20 participants against baseline methods for reaching diverse image sets; the outcome is diversity of a user-steered image set within a person, not across people, and the sample is below 50.

Classroom quasi-experiment comparing an entrepreneurship course section encouraged to use generative AI for brainstorming startup ideas (n=53) with a section without AI (n=46); rubric scores were similar; assignment is by section, not random.

System paper with a small within-person comparison (two groups of three) of brainstorming by humans alone versus humans with GPT-3.5 IBIS agents, counting comments, ideas, and topics; order not randomized (themes differ by scenario), far below 50.

Solo-brainstorming system that shows a real-time uniqueness score computed against an LLM-generated idea set, compared with a baseline condition on idea quantity, quality, and diversity (no significant gains); whether showing a score against LLM ideas counts as generative-AI assistance is borderline, and sample size is not stated.
Randomized 2 x 2 field experiment with 371 professionals in South Korea (individuals vs teams, with vs without GenAI) on an open-ended innovation challenge, with expert-evaluated solution quality.

Online experiment (N=200) in which people wrote self-introductions with sentence-completion suggestions from a model fine-tuned to favor interest, work, or hospitality topics; the outcome is topic choice (convergence toward the AI's topic), not a creativity or diversity score, so eligibility under criterion 3 needs a full-text check.
